answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on two publicly available datasets, namely Europarl-7 and IWSLT-10, covering 6 and 9 languages from/to English respectively. ... we translate documents ... using multilingual DocNMT and SenNMT models.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU to measure the general translation quality. Document-level BLEU is calculated by counting n-gram at the document level ... we also introduce gendered pronoun F1 ... and employ accuracy on contrastive test sets.

answer_4.quote: The translated documents are presented to bilingual human raters who are native in the non-English locale. The raters assign a score in a 0-6 scale to every sentence-translation pair in the document, where 0 and 6 mean nonsense and perfect translations, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate each sentence translation within its full document context and assign a quality score from 0 (nonsense) to 6 (perfect).
